name: Virtual Try-On for Shops
author: mickmwanzia

sections.description:
Virtual Try-On for Shops lets your customers see your products on themselves before they buy. They take a photo with their phone’s camera, or upload one, and see themselves wearing your jacket, glasses or necklace in seconds, right on your product page.

No API keys, no accounts to set up: install, answer two quick questions, and the button is live.

Why store owners use it

  • More confident buyers: shoppers see the product on themselves, not just on a model
  • Fewer returns: fewer “it didn’t look like I expected” returns
  • Looks like it belongs: a quiet button that matches your theme, and a clean try-on window that works on any theme
  • Two-minute setup: a three-step setup, no API key needed

What shoppers get

  • Take a photo or upload one: on phones the button opens the phone’s own camera; on computers there’s a camera with a positioning guide
  • Their real photo, their real face: only the product changes. The shopper’s face and the background of their photo are kept exactly as they were
  • Try every colour: on variable products, shoppers can switch colours on the result and see each one using the same photo
  • Add to cart from the result: one tap adds the item (and the chosen colour) to the cart
  • Helpful tips that match the product: face tips for glasses, full-body tips for dresses, pet tips for collars
  • Private by design: photos are used only to create the try-on and are never stored

Built into WooCommerce

  • Settings in WooCommerce › Settings › Try-On, using WooCommerce’s own fields
  • A Try-On tab on every product: turn it on or off, choose which product photo the AI uses, and correct the item type if needed
  • Variable products: the shopper’s chosen variation photo is used automatically
  • Works with any page builder through the [vtofs_button] shortcode (Elementor, Breakdance, Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen and more)
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks
  • Translation ready

Product types

  • Clothing: tops, jackets, dresses, trousers, skirts, matching sets, shoes
  • Eyewear: glasses and sunglasses
  • Jewellery: necklaces, earrings, bracelets, watches, rings
  • Accessories: hats, scarves, ties, belts, bags, hair and wigs
  • Pet products: collars, harnesses, pet clothing and accessories

The product type is detected from your categories and product names, and you can change it per product.

Plans

  • Free: 10 try-ons a month, no card needed
  • Starter: $9 a month for 100 try-ons
  • Growth: $24 a month for 400 try-ons
  • Pro: $49 a month for 1,000 try-ons

Yearly billing gives you two months free. Upgrade any time from WooCommerce › Settings › Try-On › Plan & usage. When you reach your monthly allowance, the button quietly hides until the next month, so shoppers never see an error.

Lifetime licence holders keep unlimited try-ons on their own fal.ai account.

External Services

This plugin needs an external AI service to create try-ons. It connects to the services below.

Virtual Try-On service (default)

Try-ons run on our own service. Your site sends the try-on to our server, which creates it with our AI model hosted on Modal (modal.com) and returns the result.

  • What’s sent when a shopper uses try-on: the shopper’s photo, the product image, the product name and type, and your website address
  • What’s sent to check your plan: your website address and licence key (if you have one), when product pages and the plugin’s settings are loaded (cached for 5 minutes)
  • Endpoint: https://virtualtryonwoo.com/api/v1/tryon.php
  • Storage: photos are used only to create the try-on and are not kept by the plugin or our server. Results are held briefly by the AI host so your site can collect them, then discarded.

Our service: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
Modal (AI hosting): Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Polar (checkout for paid plans)

Paid plans are sold through Polar. Choosing a plan opens Polar’s checkout in a new tab, with your store email filled in. Nothing is sent to Polar until you click a plan.

Polar: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

fal.ai (lifetime licences using their own key)

If you have a lifetime licence and add your own fal.ai key, try-ons are sent directly to fal.ai on your own account instead.

  • What’s sent: the shopper’s photo, the product image and processing instructions
  • When: only when a shopper takes or uploads a photo
  • Endpoint: https://queue.fal.run/fal-ai/nano-banana/edit

fal.ai: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Licence and email service

  • What’s sent: your licence key and website address (to check a licence), and the email you enter during setup (for setup help, and tips only if you opt in)
  • Endpoint: https://virtualtryonwoo.com/api/v1/

Our service: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Support

For help and documentation: https://virtualtryonwoo.com/support

Privacy Policy

This plugin integrates with external services (see External Services above):

  1. Virtual Try-On service (our server and our AI host, Modal): creates try-ons from the shopper’s photo. Photos are not stored. See https://virtualtryonwoo.com/privacy and https://modal.com/legal/privacy-policy
  2. fal.ai (only for lifetime licences using their own key): creates try-ons on the store owner’s fal.ai account. See https://fal.ai/privacy
  3. Plan and licence checks: only your website address and licence key are sent. No shopper data.
  4. Polar: only when the store owner chooses a paid plan.

The plugin adds suggested text to Settings › Privacy › Policy guide. Add it to your privacy policy so shoppers know how try-on photos are used.

Credits

Try-ons run on our own AI service, built on the open Qwen-Image-Edit model (Apache 2.0). Premium licence holders can use Fal AI with their own key.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins › Add New, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce 7.0 or newer is required
  3. Follow the three-step setup: your email, where the button should appear, and you’re live
  4. Change anything later in WooCommerce › Settings › Try-On, or per product in its Try-On tab

To place the button yourself, use [vtofs_button] or [vtofs_button product_id="123"].
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key or an AI account?

No. Try-ons run on our service, and the free plan works straight away. Lifetime licence holders can still use their own fal.ai key if they prefer.

How many free try-ons do I get?

10 a month, every month. Paid plans start at $9 a month for 100 try-ons.

What happens when I run out?

The Try-On button hides until your allowance resets on the 1st of the month, or until you upgrade. Shoppers never see an error, and store admins see a short note on the product page explaining why.

Are customer photos stored?

No. Photos are sent to the AI only to create the try-on. They are not saved in your Media Library, on our server, or by the plugin.

Will the customer still look like themselves?

Yes. Only the product changes. The shopper’s face and the background of their photo are kept from the original photo.

Which products work best?

Clothing, glasses, jewellery, hats, shoes and pet accessories. A clear photo of the item on its own works best. You can choose which product photo the AI uses in each product’s Try-On tab.

Does it work on phones?

Yes. On phones, “Take a photo” opens the phone’s own camera, and the try-on window is designed for small screens.

Does it work with my theme and page builder?

Yes. The button follows your theme’s button styles, the try-on window is designed to look right on any theme, and the [vtofs_button] shortcode works in Elementor, Breakdance, Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen and others.

Can I choose which products show the button?

Yes: all products, selected categories, or only where you place the shortcode. Each product can also override this in its Try-On tab.

Does it support wall paint?

Not at the moment. Paint products don’t show the button.
